mapper.select: SELECT SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.ID, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.PARK_ID, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.VEHICLE_PLATE, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.DRIVER_NAME, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.DRIVER_PHONE, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.SUPPLIER, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.ARRIVAL_TIME, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.LEAVE_TIME, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.PLAN_CODE, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.STATUS, SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT WHERE SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT."ID" = #{cardNo}
mapper.update: update SMT_LOGISTICS_APPOINTMENT SLA SET SLA.STATUS = 4 WHERE SLA.STATUS = 1 AND SLA.END_TIME < TO_Date(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss'),'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss')
